category_rationales.architecture: Clean Microkernel + Event-Driven Extension Hook architecture in htmx v4.0.1: a single zero-dependency core engine (src/htmx.js, 1,989 non-blank LOC) encapsulating HCON, RequestQueue, and Htmx with build-time lowering (`sed -e 's/__/#/g'`) to native ES2022 `#` private fields, paired with 17 acyclic IIFE extensions interacting exclusively through `htmx.registerExtension()` and a curated 15-method `#internalAPI` bridge.
category_rationales.code_quality: Modern ES2022 implementation using native `fetch()`, `AbortController`, `ReadableStream`, `MutationObserver`, `IntersectionObserver`, and constructable `CSSStyleSheet`, with 4 minor loose inequality (`!=`) checks in the DOM morphing engine (`src/htmx.js:2044,2100,2127,2194`) and 2 extension `fetch()` calls (`hx-preload.js:54`, `hx-download.js:33`) omitting an explicit `AbortSignal` timeout.
category_rationales.typing: Comprehensive 772-line TypeScript declaration file (`src/htmx.d.ts`) exported via `package.json` (`types: src/htmx.d.ts`), modeling `Htmx`, `HtmxConfig` (36 options), `HtmxRequestCtx`, `HtmxExtension`, `HtmxEventMap` (28 typed lifecycle events), and reactive `HxLive` proxy types.
category_rationales.testing: 1,854 real-browser test cases across 46 suites in `test/tests/`, achieving 93.5% line coverage (`6,267 / 6,706` statements) and 92.3% branch coverage in headless Chromium (`@web/test-runner` + Playwright), with 1 timing-sensitive 1ms timer race (`test/tests/ext/hx-ws.js:299`) and an external unpkg CDN `<script>` tag for `chai@4.5.0` in `test/web-test-runner.config.mjs:20`.
category_rationales.dependencies: Zero production runtime dependencies (`dependencies: {}` in `package.json`) and a committed `package-lock.json` (`0` unpinned specs); deducted modestly for 5 HIGH and 15 MEDIUM transitive advisories in `devDependencies` (`cross-spawn@7.0.3`, `ip-address@9.0.5`, `basic-ftp@5.3.1`, `qs@6.15.3`) and the absence of a configured static linter or `engines.node` field.
category_rationales.security: Strong hypermedia security engineering with zero runtime supply-chain dependencies, zero secrets, W3C Trusted Types policy integration (`#ttPolicy` in `src/htmx.js:230-241`), `hx-ignore` subtree sandboxing, and the eval-free `src/ext/hx-csp.js` strict-CSP evaluator; deducted for direct `.innerHTML`/`.outerHTML` assignments in `src/ext/hx-live.js:612-613,796` and `src/ext/hx-head.js:59` that bypass core's Trusted Types wrapper, and for missing `SECURITY.md`.
category_rationales.documentation: Exceptional technical documentation comprising 4 LLM/developer skills guides (`src/skills/*.md` shipped in the npm tarball), `CHANGELOG.md`, `src/htmx.d.ts`, and a 4-portal bilingual documentation suite (`docs_src/`, `api_src/`, `architecture_src/`, `reports_src/`).

system_profile.system_purpose: A zero-dependency, hypermedia-oriented JavaScript browser library (htmx v4.0.1) that enables any HTML element to issue HTTP requests via the native Fetch API and reconcile server-rendered HTML fragments into the live DOM using swaps, <hx-partial> tags, Out-of-Band updates, and built-in Idiomorph DOM tree morphing.
system_profile.domain_context: Hypermedia-Driven Applications (HDA) and HATEOAS web frontend engineering, providing declarative HTML attributes (hx-get, hx-post, hx-trigger, hx-target, hx-swap, hx-status:XXX, :inherited), colon-separated DOM lifecycle events, and 17 official extensions (SSE, WebSockets, multipart streaming, reactive hx-live proxies, strict CSP evaluator).
external_integrations: Browser Fetch API & HTTP/HTTPS Hypermedia Servers (HX-* Request/Response Headers)
Browser History API & sessionStorage (via src/htmx.js & src/ext/hx-history-cache.js)
Trusted Types API & Content Security Policy (via #ttPolicy & src/ext/hx-csp.js)

structure_map.architecture_pattern: Microkernel + Event-Driven Extension Hook Architecture (Core ES2022 Htmx Engine with #internalAPI Bridge and 17 Opt-In IIFE Extensions)

layers.name: Core Hypermedia Runtime & DOM Reconciler
layers.responsibility: Provides HCON configuration parsing, RequestQueue synchronization, explicit :inherited attribute resolution, trigger/selector lexers, Fetch API request orchestration, <hx-partial>/OOB task extraction, and built-in Idiomorph DOM tree reconciliation.

layers.responsibility: Extends the Fetch and event lifecycle with Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, multipart/mixed streaming responses, speculative preloading, conditional PTag polling, and file download swaps.

layers.responsibility: Provides reactive DOM state proxies (hx-live), strict CSP AST evaluation without eval (hx-csp), sessionStorage history caching, head merging, multi-target/upsert swaps, and htmx 2 / Alpine.js compatibility bridges.

modules.health_note: 1,989 non-blank LOC; exposes 15 curated primitives to extensions via #internalAPI.

modules.role: Streaming multipart/mixed parser and incremental swapper over Fetch ReadableStream

modules.health_note: 754 non-blank LOC; integrates with MutationObserver and htmx lifecycle hooks.

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Strictly unidirectional microkernel boundary: src/htmx.js has zero dependencies on any extension, while all 17 extensions in src/ext/*.js interact with the core exclusively through htmx.registerExtension(name, hooks) and the 15 bound methods passed to init(internalAPI).

execution_flows.name: DOM Subtree Processing & Trigger Registration
execution_flows.trigger: DOMContentLoaded -> htmx.initialize() -> htmx.process(document.body) or MutationObserver / manual htmx.process(root)
steps: Dispatches htmx:before:process on root and skips subtrees matching hx-ignore (__ignore)
Queries descendants with hx-get/post/put/patch/delete/query/action (#actionSelector) or hx-boost (__maybeBoost)
Evaluates XPath #hxOnQuery to bind inline hx-on:* handlers (__handleHxOnAttributes)
Initializes elt._htmx metadata (__initializeElement), parses hx-trigger specs via HCON (__parseTriggerSpecs), and registers event/IntersectionObserver/polling listeners (__onTrigger)

execution_flows.name: Declarative Fetch Request & RequestQueue Synchronization
execution_flows.trigger: DOM event matching registered hx-trigger spec or programmatic htmx.ajax(verb, path, options)
steps: Constructs HtmxRequestCtx (__createRequestContext) resolving target (__resolveTarget), explicit :inherited attributes (__attributeValue), core HX-* headers (__createCoreHeaders), and FormData (__collectFormData)
Evaluates hx-confirm and dispatches htmx:confirm (suspending if preventDefault() is called until issueRequest())
Resolves hx-sync queue owner (__getRequestQueue) and admits request via RequestQueue.admit(strategy) supporting drop, abort, replace, and queue first/last/all

Dispatches htmx:config:request and htmx:before:request, arms AbortController timeout (__initTimeout), executes fetch(), and extracts HX-* response headers (__extractHxHeaders) plus hx-status:XXX overrides (__handleStatusCodes)

execution_flows.name: Multi-Task DOM Swap, <hx-partial> Extraction & Idiomorph Reconciliation
steps: Parses response HTML into DocumentFragment (__makeFragment) while preserving [hx-preserve] elements in a temporary pantry (__handlePreservedElements)
Extracts <hx-partial> tasks (__processPartials), main swap task (__processMainSwap), and hx-swap-oob tasks (__processOOB) in strict htmx 4 order (Main -> Partials -> OOB)
Dispatches htmx:before:swap and executes each task via __insertContent (running __morph for innerMorph/outerMorph or DOM insertion for innerHTML/outerHTML/outerSync)

Queues View Transitions via __submitTransitionTask or runs CSS attribute settling (htmx:before:settle -> htmx:after:settle), executes scripts with inlineScriptNonce (__processScripts), and updates browser history (__handleHistoryUpdate)

state_and_storage: Per-element expando property elt._htmx storing eventHandler, listeners, RequestQueue instance, and extension state
Htmx singleton private fields (#internalAPI, __extMethods Map, __registeredExt Set, #transitionQueue)
Browser History state object ({ htmx: true }) and optional sessionStorage LRU cache in src/ext/hx-history-cache.js
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Asynchronous Promise-based pipeline built on native fetch() and AbortController. Concurrent requests on synchronized elements are serialized or cancelled by RequestQueue (drop, abort, replace, queue first/last/all). View Transitions are serialized through #transitionQueue. Network/swap exceptions fire htmx:error while HTTP >= 400 responses fire htmx:response:error and route through hx-status:XXX.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Evaluated supply-chain CVEs, container/IaC hardening, secrets, CWE dangerous sinks, and governance (common/security_vulnerability, common/supply_chain) for htmx v4.0.1. Production htmx bundles (dist/htmx.js, dist/htmx.esm.js, dist/htmax.js) have 0 runtime dependencies (ProjectFacts.dependencies = []), 0 leaked secrets, and 0 container misconfigurations. In Trivy's scan, the 29 'runtime_core' package CVEs (tar@6.2.1, brace-expansion@2.0.1, glob@10.4.2, minimatch@9.0.5) originate from the global /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm inside the non-shipped node:22-bookworm test-harness image, while 22 dev_or_optional CVEs (5 HIGH, 15 MEDIUM, 2 LOW, 0 CRITICAL) reside in transitive devDependencies in package-lock.json (cross-spawn@7.0.3, ip-address@9.0.5, basic-ftp@5.3.1, extract-zip@2.0.1). Static CWE analysis confirms core htmx integrates W3C Trusted Types (#ttPolicy in src/htmx.js:230), hx-ignore sandboxing, and the eval-free hx-csp extension, though src/ext/hx-head.js:59 and src/ext/hx-live.js:612-613,796 assign to innerHTML/outerHTML directly without routing through core's Trusted Types wrapper.

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret JavaScript AST Facts & Evaluate Quality/JSDoc-Types/Imports/Security
audit_dimensions.summary: Analyzed deterministic JavaScript AST facts across 18 source modules (5,521 non-blank LOC: src/htmx.js at 1,989 LOC plus 17 official extensions in src/ext/). The v4.0.1 rewrite replaces htmx 2's 4,000+ line closure with a clean ES2022 class architecture (HCON, RequestQueue, Htmx) backed by a comprehensive 772-line TypeScript declaration file (src/htmx.d.ts). Flagged AST items reflect deliberate browser-runtime trade-offs (top-level var htmx for IIFE/script-tag distribution, empty catch blocks for progressive DOM feature fallbacks such as CSSStyleSheet and moveBefore, and innerHTML/outerHTML in DOM swap extensions), alongside actionable improvements such as propagating AbortSignal timeouts in hx-preload.js/hx-download.js and replacing remaining != checks in the morph engine with !==.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Node/JavaScript Build, Supply Chain & Dependencies
audit_dimensions.summary: Evaluated repository structure, dependency manifest (package.json + package-lock.json), documentation, and supply-chain governance for htmx v4.0.1. The project maintains a zero-runtime-dependency architecture (0 production dependencies, 6 pinned devDependencies in package-lock.json), dual licensing (BSD-0-Clause for upstream htmx in LICENSE-HTMX and Apache-2.0 in LICENSE), a comprehensive 7-section root README.md, and a hardened non-root Playwright test harness Dockerfile.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Evaluated containerized runtime verification (common/runtime_verification) and SRE production readiness (common/production_readiness) for htmx v4.0.1. Stage 1 built the hermetic Node 22 + Playwright Chromium container image cleanly in 127.33s. Stage 2 executed 1,854 real-browser test cases offline (--network=none) via @web/test-runner + Headless Chromium in 61.33s with 1,849 passing, 4 skipped, and 1 timing-sensitive race in test/tests/ext/hx-ws.js:299 (`await htmx.timeout(1)` racing against mockWebSocket's auto-open timer under multi-tab CPU load), achieving 93.5% line coverage (6,267 / 6,706 statements) and 92.3% branch coverage across src/htmx.js and src/ext/*.js. Stage 3 verified both the dist/htmx.js bundle and the upgrade-check CLI smoke probe with exit code 0.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Public API Boundaries, Import Purity, SemVer & Diátaxis Docs
audit_dimensions.summary: Evaluated library hygiene (common/library_guidelines) and documentation standards (common/documentation) for htmx v4.0.1. The library exposes a strictly bounded public API (12 public methods on the htmx singleton plus version and config, with all 86 internal methods lowered to ES2022 '#' private fields in dist/htmx.js and dist/htmx.esm.js), maintains zero runtime dependencies, gates console event logging behind htmx.config.logAll = false, and provides multi-format distribution bundles (IIFE, ESM, minified, htmax bundle, TypeScript declarations, and JetBrains web-types).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate JavaScript Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: Evaluated the htmx v4.0.1 JavaScript test suite against javascript/testing standards. The test suite comprises 88 test modules under test/tests/ (44 unit, 23 attributes, 6 end2end, 15 ext) containing 1,849 Mocha/Chai test cases executed in real headless browsers via @web/test-runner and Playwright. Deterministic isolation is enforced via test/lib/fetch-mock.js and per-test DOM/extension teardown in setupTest()/cleanupTest(). All 47 AST-flagged assertion-free candidates were inspected and confirmed to invoke custom assertion helpers defined in test/lib/helpers.js (such as assertTextContentIs).

strengths: Zero runtime npm dependencies (dependencies: 0), eliminating transitive supply-chain risk for end-user browsers.

Complete package export metadata in package.json covering IIFE (dist/htmx.js), ES Module (dist/htmx.esm.js), CDN minified (dist/htmx.min.js), TypeScript declarations (dist/htmx.d.ts), JetBrains web-types, and the upgrade-check CLI bin.
Deterministic lockfile (package-lock.json) pinning all 6 devDependencies (@web/test-runner, @web/test-runner-playwright, terser, brotli-cli, ws, @tailwindcss/typography).
Explicit prototype pollution guard in HCON.merge (src/htmx.js:75) filtering '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype'.

Clever build-time encapsulation: internal methods use '__' in src/htmx.js for direct unit testability and are lowered via sed into native ES2022 '#' private fields in dist/htmx.js and dist/htmx.esm.js.
Full 772-line TypeScript declaration file (src/htmx.d.ts) typing all 28 colon-separated HtmxEventMap events and HxLive reactive proxies.

Build-time private field lowering (`sed -e 's/__/#/g'`) guarantees that internal methods (`__attributeValue`, `__issueRequest`, `__morph`, etc.) are hard-encapsulated as ES2022 `#` private members in `dist/htmx.js` and `dist/htmx.esm.js` while remaining directly unit-testable in `src/htmx.js`.
Zero runtime dependencies and silent-by-default operation (`htmx.config.logAll = false`), ensuring zero uninvited console noise in production browsers.

Rich multi-target distribution: IIFE (`dist/htmx.js`), ES Module (`dist/htmx.esm.js`), all-in-one extension bundle (`dist/htmax.js`), TypeScript definitions (`dist/htmx.d.ts`), and JetBrains Web-Types (`dist/editors/jetbrains/htmx.web-types.json`).

1,849 browser test cases organized into 4 clear tiers: 44 internal unit suites (`test/tests/unit/`), 23 attribute suites (`test/tests/attributes/`), 6 end-to-end integration suites (`test/tests/end2end/`), and 15 official extension suites (`test/tests/ext/`).

Deterministic network and DOM isolation: `test/lib/fetch-mock.js` intercepts `window.fetch` without external servers, while `cleanupTest()` in `test/lib/helpers.js` runs `htmx.__cleanup(pg)`, resets `fetchMock`, and restores `history.replaceState`.
Cross-browser Playwright harness (`test:chrome`, `test:firefox`, `test:webkit`) configured in `package.json` and `test/web-test-runner.config.mjs`.
Exceptional measured V8 browser coverage: 93.5% line coverage (`6,267 / 6,706` statements) and 92.3% branch coverage across `src/htmx.js` and all 17 official extensions.
1,849 passing real-browser tests executed in headless Chromium with `--network=none` in 61.33 seconds.
60-second default `AbortController` request timeout (`htmx.config.defaultTimeout = 60000`) built directly into `Htmx.__initTimeout` (`src/htmx.js:679`).

Zero production runtime dependencies (`dependencies: {}` in `package.json`), completely eliminating third-party supply-chain risk from shipped browser bundles (`dist/htmx.js`, `dist/htmx.esm.js`, `dist/htmax.js`).

First-class browser security defenses built into v4: W3C Trusted Types policy integration (`__initSecurity` / `#ttPolicy` in `src/htmx.js:230-241`), `hx-ignore` subtree sandboxing, `inlineScriptNonce` support, and the `src/ext/hx-csp.js` AST expression evaluator for strict `script-src` CSP environments.
Zero hardcoded secrets or credentials (`SecurityFacts.secrets = []`, `AstFacts.hardcoded_secrets = []`) across the entire codebase.

findings.evidence: Trivy scan of package-lock.json reported 5 HIGH and 15 MEDIUM transitive devDependency CVEs (e.g., CVE-2024-21538 in cross-spawn@7.0.3 -> fix 7.0.5; CVE-2026-69192 in ip-address@9.0.5 -> fix 10.3.1; CVE-2026-102990 in basic-ftp@5.3.1 -> fix 6.2.1; CVE-2026-82417 in qs@6.15.3 -> fix 6.16.0)
findings.description: While `htmx.org` ships zero runtime dependencies, `package-lock.json` contains transitive `devDependencies` used by `@web/test-runner` and `playwright` with known HIGH/MEDIUM advisories that have upstream patched versions.
findings.recommendation: Run `npm audit fix` (or add `overrides` in `package.json` for `cross-spawn >=7.0.5`, `ip-address >=10.7.1`, `basic-ftp >=6.2.1`, and `qs >=6.16.0`) to keep the development lockfile clean.

findings.evidence: src/ext/hx-live.js:612 (`elt.innerHTML = val`), 613 (`elt.outerHTML = val`), and 796 (`elt.innerHTML = ...`); src/ext/hx-head.js:59 (`htmlDoc.innerHTML = text`)
findings.description: Core `src/htmx.js` wraps HTML strings through its W3C Trusted Types policy (`#ttPolicy.createHTML` in `src/htmx.js:230-241`), but `src/ext/hx-live.js:612-613,796` and `src/ext/hx-head.js:59` assign strings directly to `.innerHTML`/`.outerHTML`, which throws under strict `require-trusted-types-for 'script'` CSP headers and can introduce DOM XSS if bound to untrusted data.
findings.recommendation: Expose core's Trusted Types HTML wrapper via `#internalAPI` and route `.innerHTML` / `.outerHTML` assignments in `src/ext/hx-live.js` and `src/ext/hx-head.js` through it.

findings.symbol: Message Sending.queues a message until the initial connection opens
findings.evidence: test/tests/ext/hx-ws.js:299 awaits `htmx.timeout(1)` before asserting `connection.queue.length === 1`, which races against mockWebSocket's open timer under parallel browser runner load
findings.description: In `test/tests/ext/hx-ws.js:299`, `await htmx.timeout(1)` can resolve after the mock WebSocket auto-open timer fires under heavy CPU concurrency, causing `connection.queue.length` to already be 0 (flaky failure).
findings.recommendation: Control mockWebSocket connection opening explicitly in the test (or increase the mock open delay relative to the pre-open assertion) rather than relying on a 1ms wall-clock `setTimeout` race.

findings.evidence: src/ext/hx-preload.js:54 and src/ext/hx-download.js:33 invoke fetch() without passing ctx.request.signal or AbortSignal.timeout()
findings.description: Extension-initiated fetch() calls in hx-preload.js and hx-download.js do not attach an AbortSignal timeout, allowing stalled prefetch or download connections to remain pending.
findings.recommendation: Pass `signal: ctx.request.signal` or `AbortSignal.timeout(htmx.config.defaultTimeout)` to extension fetch() calls.

findings.evidence: src/htmx.js:2044, 2100, 2127, 2194 use loose inequality `!=` instead of strict `!==`
findings.description: Four comparisons inside the DOM morphing methods (__morphChildren, __findBestMatch, __morphNode) use loose inequality (!=) rather than strict inequality (!==).
findings.recommendation: Replace `!=` with strict `!==` (or explicit `!= null` check where null/undefined equivalence is intended) in the morphing subsystem.

action_plan.title: Route innerHTML/outerHTML assignments in hx-live.js and hx-head.js through core Trusted Types policy
action_plan.action: Expose a Trusted Types helper on `#internalAPI` in `src/htmx.js` and use it in `src/ext/hx-live.js:612,613,796` and `src/ext/hx-head.js:59` before assigning to `.innerHTML` or `.outerHTML`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Ensures full compatibility with `require-trusted-types-for 'script'` CSP policies across all official extensions.

action_plan.title: Eliminate 1ms timer race in hx-ws.js message queue unit test
action_plan.action: In `test/tests/ext/hx-ws.js:293-310`, trigger mockWebSocket open deterministically (or increase mock auto-open latency) after asserting `connection.queue.length === 1` instead of relying on `await htmx.timeout(1)`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Makes the 1,854-test Playwright browser suite 100% deterministic under high parallel concurrency.

action_plan.title: Attach AbortSignal timeout to extension fetch() calls in hx-preload and hx-download
action_plan.action: Propagate `ctx.request.signal` or `AbortSignal.timeout(htmx.config.defaultTimeout)` into the `fetch()` options in `src/ext/hx-preload.js:54` and `src/ext/hx-download.js:33`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Prevents hung background prefetch or download requests from leaking browser connections.

action_plan.title: Standardize strict equality (!==) in DOM morphing routines
action_plan.action: Replace loose `!=` checks at lines 2044, 2100, 2127, and 2194 of `src/htmx.js` with strict `!==` comparisons.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates coercive equality checks in hot DOM tree reconciliation loops.

action_plan.title: Declare engines.node and static lint script in package.json
action_plan.action: Add an engines field specifying Node >=20 and configure Biome or ESLint in devDependencies for static syntax/style verification.
action_plan.expected_impact: Enforces consistent Node runtime expectations and catches syntax regressions prior to browser test runs.

action_plan.title: Add SECURITY.md and Dependabot configuration for automated supply-chain hygiene
action_plan.action: Create `SECURITY.md` with vulnerability reporting instructions and `.github/dependabot.yml` for automated `npm` lockfile PRs.
action_plan.expected_impact: Satisfies OpenSSF Scorecard supply-chain governance checks and prevents devDependency drift.

summary: htmx v4.0.1 achieves an overall PNI501 engineering score of 91/100 (Grade S). The ground-up v4 rewrite replaces legacy XMLHttpRequest callbacks with a zero-dependency ES2022 class engine (`Htmx`, `RequestQueue`, `HCON`) backed by native `fetch()`, `AbortController`, `ReadableStream`, built-in Idiomorph DOM morphing, and 17 acyclic extensions. Hermetic headless Chromium verification executed 1,854 browser tests with 93.5% line coverage and 92.3% branch coverage. Key improvement opportunities focus on refreshing transitive `devDependencies` in `package-lock.json`, routing `.innerHTML` assignments in `hx-live.js` and `hx-head.js` through core's W3C Trusted Types policy, and eliminating a 1ms timer race in `test/tests/ext/hx-ws.js:299`.
